intent: Welcome: What Gator can do adds Vault and the read-only Dashboard
notes: "What Gator can do" gains a "Drafts and review" section after the
capability cards, with two parts. Gator Vault (`.gator/vault/`) is a
local staging area for drafts and research: out of Git, but visible in
the Dashboard until the work is ready to become shared knowledge. The
Dashboard is a read-only, Git-backed inspection surface, including
earlier versions of files. The agent changes the repository; the
Dashboard helps the human understand and govern those changes.
A new diagram shows work moving from the agent session to the vault,
